fields.statement: At b11bed21, as verifier: go test -trimpath ./cmd/rhiza -run 'TestScripts/(change-request-kind|describe-golden)$' passes. change-request-kind.txtar shows that a change set from rhiza change new prints request_kind feature and no workflow in change show --json (and '- Request kind: feature' with no Workflow line in human output). It also shows that a queued bug request, whose queue entry in .git/rhiza/requests.json the script edits to carry workflow bugfix, opened by run start --new --request, prints request_kind bug and workflow bugfix in change show --json and human output. fold-ok passes. go test -trimpath for internal/changeset, entry, store and daemon passes (new format-4 encode/decode and Validate tests included). internal/api passes, except that TestReadBudget missed its roadmap/ready what-if 50ms budget in a run beside another agent's api.test at load ~10. Re-run alone, TestReadBudget passed at both b11bed21 and its parent with matching medians (roadmap what-if 30ms vs 27ms, ready 28ms vs 38ms), so the miss was load, not this diff. The diff adds request_kind/workflow to the open body behind entry format 4 (FormatVersion 3->4; format 3 rejects the fields), threads the request's kind and workflow through newPlanChange, and adds both to ChangeShowResponse in the fold and indexed paths. Changed Go files are gofmt-clean.
